channel.title: Vandré Leal Cândido · Writing
channel.description: Thoughts on architecture, tooling, and craft.

item.title: Rebuilding my personal site
item.description: A short tour of the latest rebuild: a static-first site with no client framework, reduced motion as a real signal, and most of the work shifted to build time.

item.title: Audit Scripts for a Design System
item.description: How a style guide became a suite of audit scripts behind one umbrella command, grouped by what they protect, with parallel execution and an explicit drift-resolution workflow.

item.title: Test Layers for a Design System
item.description: Type tests, an API surface snapshot, story-level token-cascade guards, and property tests. Layered testing that catches the failure modes a design system actually has.

item.title: Caching Sharp-Processed Images in Static Builds
item.description: How I cut documentation build times by hashing image inputs, committing the preprocessed webp outputs, and skipping image work on every CI run.

item.title: Replacing Astro Image for a Documentation Site
item.description: Why I removed Astro's built-in Image component from a docs site and replaced it with a thin custom wrapper, and the lesson about when generic abstractions cost more than they save.

item.title: Custom markdownlint Rules for Docs Conventions
item.description: How I encoded the docs site's actual conventions into project-specific markdownlint rules so contributors stopped having to remember them.

item.title: Building an OpenAPI Code Generation Pipeline with Kubb
item.description: How I automated TypeScript type and Zod schema generation from OpenAPI specs using Kubb, with scheduled CI runs and team notifications for breaking changes.

item.title: Building Type-Safe APIs with OpenAPI
item.description: How the dashboard API integration layer became its own product: OpenAPI as the single source of truth across multiple consuming teams.

item.title: A Practical Prefetching Strategy with TanStack Query and Router
item.description: How I implemented intent-based preloading, route-level prefetching, and pagination prefetching to make a dashboard feel instant.

item.title: Encoding Pricing Rules Without Forking the UI
item.description: How I moved pricing math out of components and into the plan definition so a marketing site could absorb new products and billing models without UI changes.

item.title: Mocking the API Contract Before Implementing It
item.description: How shipping the API contract before the implementation removed the synchronization tax between backend and frontend teams.

item.title: Proxy Patterns for Multi-API Dashboards
item.description: How I designed a proxy layer to unify multiple APIs behind a single authentication and routing system in a React dashboard.

item.title: Hybrid Next.js: Static Export and SSR from One Codebase
item.description: How I shipped a Next.js marketing site that builds as a static export for one host and as a server-rendered app on Vercel, without forking the codebase.

item.title: Building Interactive Pricing Pages with Next.js
item.description: How I built dynamic pricing pages with range sliders, plan comparisons, and real-time calculators for a SaaS product website.
